title: Mesh Core concepts
overview: Format-neutral mesh vocabulary: coordinates, entity identity, ordered element connectivity, faces, adjacency, boundary and region groups, coordinate conventions and provenance. Format readers translate into this vocabulary without leaking source-library handles into solver-owned data.
principle: Identity differs from storage position; connectivity order carries orientation; geometric entities differ from mesh entities; physical labels remain metadata until an explicit mapping assigns solver meaning. Canonical source data must be separated from derived caches. Cell measure V_K = integral_K dV; face measure A_f = integral_f dA. For x=x(xi), J=det(partial x/partial xi); a valid local mapping requires non-singular J and consistent orientation.
architecture: Format reader -> validated value snapshot -> semantic mapping -> Mesh Core. Coordinates and source connectivity are canonical. Face incidence, normals, measures, centers, adjacency and search structures are derived and require explicit rebuild rules.

proves: MeshSnapshot v1 defines dimensioned nodes, ordered cells, owner/neighbour faces, typed groups and provenance.
Architecture distinguishes canonical mesh data from derived caches.
does_not_prove: Production C++ snapshot export from every runtime mesh path.
Automatic boundary-condition inference from physical group names.
Complete high-order, partitioned or moving-mesh preservation.

verification.scope: tools/mesh_contracts/test_snapshot.py; validates manifest invariants, not runtime export.
